description: For one candidate transition on one device class: does the person need to see the movement, or are the before and after pictures enough?
instructions: This change is about the screens below. Would watching the move from one pose to the other, on the device class in `device_class`, show the person something the two still pictures do not: a jump, a flash, content passing under the hinge, things sliding to new places, a sheet resizing, or a smoother or slower move? If what changed is only where things end up, the pictures are enough.

criteria.true: The movement itself is new, fixed, or what the request is about
criteria.false: Only the end positions differ; still pictures of the changed pose show it all

output: pr_visual select: recorded per candidate edge under jev_shadow (clip vs pair, K.2 rule 4). Shadow: the transition-code rule decides today.
